content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products online often requires navigating a complex landscape of payment processors that charge hefty fees, such as Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut on every sale. In contrast, using Bitcoin payments via NOWPayments can significantly reduce transaction costs to just 0.5%. This difference means that on 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain an extra $921. This infrastructure shift not only increases profitability but also empowers creators to maintain full control over their sales without reliance on restrictive platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, utilizing Bitcoin for digital downloads involves a combination of robust technologies that work seamlessly together. The process begins with your product hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that delivery is reliable and cost-effective. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on the blockchain. This setup eliminates the need for middlemen, allowing creators to receive funds directly. Furthermore, automated delivery can be managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, enhancing efficiency in product fulfillment while keeping operational costs low.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators who are often sidelined by mainstream payment platforms. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or digital art, this infrastructure is designed specifically for you. It serves creators in regions facing payment access issues, such as Ghana or Zimbabwe, where traditional platforms have failed. By providing a streamlined, cost-effective way to sell digital products, this architecture enables creators to thrive in environments that would otherwise stifle their potential.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture of a Bitcoin payment system for digital downloads comprises several critical components. First, a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the storefront. Next, backend logic is managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handle customer interactions and order processing. For payment verification, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that transactions are efficient. Lastly, data storage can be managed via Supabase or Google Sheets, providing creators with full ownership over their sales data and customer information.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this infrastructure, start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up your product files for delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Then, integrate NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. Use either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order delivery upon payment confirmation. Finally, ensure that all your data is stored securely using Supabase or Google Sheets. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for a seamless deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments, which seamlessly integrates with your digital storefront. This method eliminates high platform fees, allowing you to retain more profit. By leveraging infrastructure like GitHub Pages and automated delivery systems, you can efficiently sell your digital products without relying on conventional payment processors.
Automate product delivery with minimal effort using Cloudflare Workers.

Set up NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions seamlessly. 4. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated product delivery upon payment confirmation. 5. Store your sales data securely with Supabase or Google Sheets for full ownership.
